title: Closed-fibre admissible-modification presentation of open cohomology
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair, with $I$ finitely generated, and let $A'=\widehat A$ be its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, $U=X\setminus V(I)$, and define $X',Z',U'$ by base change to $A'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-base-change]. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $U$ and $F'$ its inverse image on $U'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For finitely generated ideals $J$ with $V(J)=V(I)$, form $B_J=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$, $Z_J=B_J\times_XZ$, and $j_J:U\hookrightarrow B_J$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. Order these blowups by domination, identifying ideals giving the same blowup. Their closed fibres form a cofiltered system. The limit of their small etale topoi, denoted $\mathcal T$, has a conservative family of geometric points (compatible geometric points of the closed fibres). Write $p_J:\mathcal T\to (Z_J)_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the projections and
$$L^q_F=\varinjlim_Jp_J^{-1}\bigl((R^qj_{J*}F)|_{Z_J}\bigr)\quad(q\geq0).$$
Here $R^qj_*$ is the higher direct image on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and the transition maps are the natural pullback/exchange maps. There is a natural first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_2^{p,q}=H^p(\mathcal T,L^q_F)\ \Longrightarrow\ H^{p+q}(U_{\mathrm{et}},F).$$
Cohomology on a topos means the right derived functors of global sections, as for [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Convergence gives, in total degree $n\geq0$, a filtration with $n+1$ graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Completion identifies $\mathcal T$ with the corresponding limit topos for $(A',IA')$, by the identifications of the closed fibres of corresponding admissible blowups; the blowups extended from $A$ are cofinal among those for $A'$. Under this identification the exchange maps induce a morphism $L^q_F\to L^q_{F'}$ and a morphism of the displayed spectral sequences. On their abutments it is the canonical pullback $H^n(U,F)\to H^n(U',F')$, including the specified filtrations. No isomorphism of the coefficient sheaves $L^q$ or of the abutments is asserted.
